# RepairStation

> Mobile PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X repair service in Miami, Florida.
> We pick up your console or controller from your door, repair it, and deliver it
> back — typically within 3 days, or the same day with optional same-day service.
> No store visit required.

## Relaunch (November 2026)

RepairStation relaunched in November 2026 as a PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X
specialist. The information on this page and on https://repairstationmiami.com/ is
current. Older listings, reviews, or AI answers may describe the previous business,
which repaired Nintendo Switch, Steam Deck, ASUS ROG Ally and Xbox Series S, offered
disc drive, charging port and "won't power on" repairs, served Pinecrest, and was open
daily 11am–11pm with tax-inclusive prices. None of that applies any more.

## Business facts

- **Name:** RepairStation
- **Founder & technician:** Pablo R. Casanova
- **Location:** Miami, Florida, United States
- **Website:** https://repairstationmiami.com/
- **Phone:** (305) 699-2750
- **Email:** contact@repairstationmiami.com
- **Hours (ET):** Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday 11:00am–8:00pm;
  Monday 11:00am–3:00pm; closed Wednesday.
- **Service model:** Mobile / pickup and delivery. There is no walk-in storefront.
- **Payment accepted:** Cash, Zelle, Cash App, Venmo, Apple Pay, Google Pay, credit and
  debit cards. Card and digital wallet payments are processed through Stripe.

## Service area

Downtown Miami (including Brickell and Coconut Grove), Wynwood (including Midtown),
Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Doral, and Key Biscayne.
Also serves the wider Miami-Dade County area on request.

## Consoles and controllers repaired

- PlayStation 5
- Xbox Series X
- DualSense (PS5) and Xbox Wireless controllers

RepairStation does not repair Xbox Series S, Nintendo Switch, Steam Deck,
ASUS ROG Ally, or other devices.

## Services and starting prices (USD, before sales tax)

Prices do not include sales tax; applicable Florida sales tax is added to the total.
Pickup and delivery are included in every price listed. There is no travel fee,
trip charge, or delivery surcharge.

- HDMI port repair — from $120
- Overheating, fan service and deep cleaning (includes thermal compound replacement) — from $80
- Controller stick drift repair (both sticks replaced with Hall effect joysticks as standard) — from $60
- Same-day service (optional add-on to any repair) — +$25
- Pickup and delivery — free

## Same-day service

- Optional, $25 on top of the repair price.
- Requests made by 3:00pm are returned the same day.
- Same-day requests made after 3:00pm are returned the next day RepairStation is open.
- Not available on Mondays or Wednesdays.
- Standard turnaround without it is typically within 3 days of pickup.

## Guarantees

- Free diagnostics.
- No fix, no fee: if the repair isn't possible or doesn't hold, there is no charge.
- Written estimate provided before any work begins.
- 30-day warranty on every completed repair.
- Customer data and saved games are left untouched for the vast majority of repairs;
  any risk to data is disclosed upfront.

## How it works

1. Customer books a pickup through the website form at https://repairstationmiami.com/#book
2. RepairStation texts to confirm a pickup window.
3. The console or controller is collected from the customer's door and a written estimate is given.
4. The repair is completed on the bench.
5. The device is delivered back, typically within 3 days of pickup, or the same day
   with same-day service.

## Payment timing

After approving the written estimate, customers may either pre-pay online or pay in
person when the console is returned. On some bookings RepairStation requires payment
to be settled before delivery; this depends on factors such as the type of repair,
the parts involved, and the pickup location. Where it applies, the customer is told
when their pickup window is confirmed.

## Policies

- Terms of Service: https://repairstationmiami.com/terms.html
- Privacy Policy: https://repairstationmiami.com/privacy.html
- Cancel free any time before approving the written estimate.
- No fix, no fee: labour is never charged if the repair can't be completed or
  doesn't hold. Special-order parts already installed are non-refundable, and
  are always disclosed in the estimate before the customer approves it.
- 30-day warranty on completed repairs; the first remedy is always a re-repair.
- No customer data is sold or shared with advertisers. The site sets no cookies
  and runs no analytics.
